item.title: Man who tried to shoot Trump at a Florida golf course gets life in prison
item.description: FORT PIERCE, Fla. (AP) — A man convicted of trying to assassinate President Donald Trump on a Florida golf course in 2024 was sentenced Wednesday to life in prison after a federal prosecutor said his crime was unacceptable “in this country or anywhere.”

item.title: Local Roundup: Crestwood girls clinch spot in WVC Tournament with win over Dallas
item.description: A strong defensive effort carried the day for Crestwood, as the Comets held Dallas to their lowest scoring output of the season with a 48-36 win on Wednesday night in Wyoming Valley Conference Division 1 girls basketball.

item.title: NBA Trade Roundup: 76ers send Jared McCain to Thunder
item.description: PHILADELPHIA (AP) — The defending champion Oklahoma City Thunder have acquired Jared McCain from the Philadelphia 76ers for a 2026 Houston Rockets first-round draft pick and three second-round picks, a person with knowledge of the trade said Wednesday.
